summary.text: Zack Hawkins is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 31 since 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Zack Hawkins assumed office in the state House on January 1, 2019, succeeding Henry Michaux Jr.
He was one of 13 North Carolina superdelegates to the 2016 Democratic National Convention and supported Hillary Clinton for the nomination.

In the 2023-2024 session, Hawkins was assigned to the Appropriations, Appropriations on Education, Education - Universities, Energy and Public Utilities, House Redistricting, and House Transportation committees.
The Democratic primary for his seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
